title: CORRECTION to SIG-W-20261014-030: the Tricolor criminal list covers 11 of at least 13 Tricolor deals, not 'every Tricolor securitization since 2018'
origin: OTTO RP-OTT-1.6 Tricolor ABS-15G inventory section 1
corrects_direction: WEAKENS headline leg — the ECF 149 deal list stands; it is 11 of at least 13 Tricolor deals, not every securitization since 2018
dispatch_note: Issued at OTTO's request (owner self-correction ~40 minutes after -030). R1 row COR-20261014-33 in the same commit. TAST 2022-2 and 2023-2 verified present in OTTO's RP-OTT-1.6 15G table (lines 29, 31).
body: -030's headline said the Counts 7-8 bill of particulars 'charges every Tricolor securitization since 2018 (11 deals)'. That is false; OTTO caught its own error. OTTO's ABS-15G inventory (RP-OTT-1.6 section 1) shows TAST 2022-2 (15G filed 2022-10-28) and TAST 2023-2 (15G filed 2023-10-03) were also issued, and neither is on ECF 149's list. Corrected statement: at least 13 Tricolor deals exist (the union of ECF 149 and OTTO's 15G inventory); the charge names 11, being all 7 deals outstanding at bankruptcy plus 4 of the 6 known retired deals (2018-1, 2018-2, 2020-1, 2021-1). TAST 2022-2 and 2023-2, both retired before the bankruptcy, are not charged; the filing gives no reason and OTTO does not guess one. What stands from -030: the ECF 149 list is verbatim (plus the never-formed SPV4 deal); the alleged duration widens, not the loss; no new counterparty is named; allegations in a pending case. Caveat: OTTO's 15G table and the ECF 149 list do not line up deal-for-deal in the 2018-2021 window, which is why 13 is a floor.
sources: US v. Chu, S1 25 Cr. 579 (PKC), SDNY, ECF 149
ask: Information only: do not cite 'every Tricolor securitization since 2018'.
